title: Member Services Policy: Medical Certificates and PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Alert Warning Days
content:
**Section 1.** For the reset of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) low-balance alert amount, where a medical certificate for the underlying service account was received in the twelve-month window, the warning days are increased by 3; where one was received in the twenty-four-month window but none in the twelve-month window, they are increased by 1; with none in the twenty-four-month window they are not increased for a certificate.

**Section 2.** The certificates are the medical certificates received for the underlying service account, as its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records show them by received date. A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

**Section 3. Bands.**

| Most recent medical certificate received | Warning days |
|---|---|
| within the twelve-month window | increased by 3 |
| within the twenty-four-month window, none within the twelve-month window | increased by 1 |
| none within the twenty-four-month window | not increased for a certificate |

**Section 4. Cases (hypothetical).** A certificate received eleven months ago increases the warning days by 3; one received thirteen months ago, with none since, by 1; one received twenty-five months ago leaves them not increased for a certificate.
